class.name: HTTPRequestTarget
class.brief_description: A reusable description of one HTTP request, sent by [HTTPRequest].

method.name: build_body
method.description: Returns the request body for [member body_type] with the placeholders replaced from [param variables]: - [constant BODY_TYPE_NONE]: an empty array. - [constant BODY_TYPE_TEXT]: [member body_text] as UTF-8. - [constant BODY_TYPE_JSON]: [member body_fields] written with [method JSON.stringify] (keys keep their order), or [member body_text] if [member body_fields] is empty. - [constant BODY_TYPE_FORM_URLENCODED]: [member body_fields] encoded like [method encode_query], or [member body_text] if [member body_fields] is empty. - [constant BODY_TYPE_BINARY]: [member body_data], unchanged.

method.name: build_headers
method.description: Returns the request headers as [code]"Name: value"[/code] lines, with the placeholders replaced from [param variables]. A [code]Content-Type[/code] header from [method get_content_type] is added unless [member headers] already has one (the name is compared without case).

method.name: build_url
method.description: Returns the full URL: [member url] with the placeholders replaced from [param variables], followed by the encoded [member query]. If [member url] already contains a query string, the parameters are appended with [code]&[/code]; a fragment ([code]#...[/code]) stays at the end.

method.name: encode_query
method.description: Encodes [param fields] as a URL query string, with the same rules as [method HTTPClient.query_string_from_dict]: keys and values are URI-encoded, an [Array] value repeats the key for each element, and a [code]null[/code] value adds only the key. [codeblock] print(HTTPRequestTarget.encode_query({ "q": "red apple", "tag": ["a", "b"], "flag": null })) # Prints "q=red%20apple&tag=a&tag=b&flag" [/codeblock]

method.name: fill_placeholders
method.description: Returns [param text] with every [code]{key}[/code] replaced by the matching value of [param variables], converted to [String]. Placeholders without a value stay unchanged.

method.name: get_content_type
method.description: Returns the [code]Content-Type[/code] for the current [member body_type]. See [method get_content_type_for].

method.name: get_content_type_for
method.description: Returns the [code]Content-Type[/code] that is sent for [param body_type]: [code]text/plain; charset=utf-8[/code], [code]application/json[/code], [code]application/x-www-form-urlencoded[/code] or [code]application/octet-stream[/code]. Returns an empty string for [constant BODY_TYPE_NONE].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the request accepts compressed response bodies and decompresses them. Replaces [member HTTPRequest.accept_gzip] for this request.
The raw body sent with [constant BODY_TYPE_BINARY]. Placeholders are not replaced.

The fields of a [constant BODY_TYPE_JSON] or [constant BODY_TYPE_FORM_URLENCODED] body. Placeholders are replaced in keys and in [String] values, also inside nested arrays and dictionaries. If empty, [member body_text] is sent instead.

The body text sent with [constant BODY_TYPE_TEXT], and with [constant BODY_TYPE_JSON] or [constant BODY_TYPE_FORM_URLENCODED] when [member body_fields] is empty. Placeholders are replaced as plain text.

The kind of body that is sent. It selects the body property that is used and the [code]Content-Type[/code] header (see [method get_content_type]). The Inspector shows only the body properties of the selected type.
The request headers as header names mapped to values, for example [code]{ "Authorization": "Bearer {token}" }[/code]. Placeholders are replaced in names and values.

The maximum number of redirects that are followed. [code]-1[/code] allows any number. Replaces [member HTTPRequest.max_redirects] for this request. [b]Note:[/b] On the Web platform, the browser follows redirects and this value is ignored.
The HTTP method (verb) of the request.
The query parameters appended to [member url], encoded with [method encode_query]. Placeholders are replaced in keys and [String] values before encoding.
The time in seconds before the request times out. [code]0.0[/code] disables the timeout. Replaces [member HTTPRequest.timeout] for this request.
The URL of the request, without the [member query] parameters, for example [code]https://example.com/api/players/{id}[/code].

constants.constant: The body is [member body_text], sent as [code]text/plain; charset=utf-8[/code].
The body is JSON built from [member body_fields] (or [member body_text]), sent as [code]application/json[/code].
The body is a URL-encoded form built from [member body_fields] (or [member body_text]), sent as [code]application/x-www-form-urlencoded[/code].
The body is [member body_data], sent as [code]application/octet-stream[/code].
